items.title: AI SDRs Cost $1 a Lead or $3,750 a Month. Humans Still Close the Deal.
items.pt: A September 2026 comparison of 13 AI sales development tools at aiagentforsales.com lists published prices from $1 per qualified lead (HubSpot Breeze Prospecting) to $3,750 a month and up for an autonomous AI BDR (11x Alice Growth). It compares those numbers with $98,000 to $173,000 a year for a fully loaded human SDR. The same page cites 2026 industry surveys: 22% of teams say they fully replaced human SDRs with AI, 45% run hybrid models, and about 2% report pure AI SDR deployments that stuck.

items.title: Retriever-Free Retrieval: Navigating Documents with Decision Models
items.pt: While language models have become dramatically more capable, retrieval still largely relies on lexical matching or similarity in fixed embedding spaces. items.title: VibeVideoBench:Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
items.pt: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a ruleconsistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events. A different route is emerging: multimodal agents that write code to render every frame and synthesize every sound. We introduce VibeVideoBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on code-driven video generation. items.title: Patient-specific rubric-based evaluation of large language models across longitudinal cancer care
items.pt: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in specialty medicine, yet existing evaluations largely focus on isolated clinical encounters rather than tracking how clinical responsibilities evolve across a longitudinal care pathway.
